rawContent: Great to see shows like @ScandalABC @GreysABC @NBCBlacklist @ANTMVH1 @MadamSecretary all weave in some version of #MeToo & #Timesup - from child brides and domestic gas lighting to systemic sexual harassment at work. Real to reel stories told so well.

Just as I was experiencing @GreysABC fatigue, it sends a strong message about #SexualHarassmentAtWorkplace. Tear down foundations by predators & rebuild with deserving women and those who were forced out! #MeToo #TimesUp #BringWomenBack
Sad to realise that all stars we idolized as kids - @BillCosby @ScottBaio #MorganFreeman are perpetrators of #MeToo acts. But not sad that it's coming out #timesup
